player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} i SimpleTak.
Ki runga i te papa, ko ōu kōhatu e tūrama ai ko '{player_stone}' ko ōu hoariri kōhatu e tūrama ai ko '{opponent_stone}'.

I tō tuari, kōwhiri tetahi pouaka kore (mā tōna index numera) ka whakapanga i tō kōhatu ki reira.
He tauira, '[12]' ka whakapanga i tō kōhatu ki te pouaka 12.

Ko tō whāinga ko te whakapiri i ngā kōhatu i runga i te papa e whā (mai runga ki raro, mai mauī ki maui).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: He hōputu nekehanga kāore i te tika
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: He tau pūtau hē {cell_num}. Me waenganui i te 0 me te {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Cell {cell_num} is already occupied. Choose an empty cell.

action.placement: Kaitakaro {current_player_id} i whakapanga i tōna tohu ({symbol}) ki roto i te pouaka {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Kaitakaro {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') i hono i ngā pūtahi e whā!
outcome.draw: Kua ki te papa. He toenga!
